newsitem.title: USA: Bear Stearns names Craig Barnett managing director.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns names Craig Barnett managing director.

text.p: Bear, Stearns & Co Inc said Tuesday that Craig Barnett joined the firm as a managing director in the Merchandising Group of the firm's Investment Banking Division.
Barnett's newly-created position represents an expansion of Bear Stearns' corporate finance coverage of the retail, apparel, and other consumer-related industries, the firm said in a statement.
Barnett comes to Bear Stearns from The Blackstone Group LP where he was a managing director since 1994.
